SELECT m.id AS material_id, m.code AS material_code, m.name AS material_name, m.spec, m.unit, m.category, t.open_qty, t.purchase_in, t.production_in, t.sales_return, t.other_in, t.sales_out, t.production_out, t.purchase_return, t.other_out, t.open_qty + t.purchase_in + t.production_in + t.sales_return + t.other_in - t.sales_out - t.production_out - t.purchase_return - t.other_out AS close_qty FROM ( SELECT x.material_id, SUM(CASE WHEN x.d < #{q.beginDate} THEN x.qty ELSE 0 END) AS open_qty, SUM(CASE WHEN x.d >= #{q.beginDate} AND x.kind = 'IN' AND x.biz_type = 'PURCHASE' THEN x.qty ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_in, SUM(CASE WHEN x.d >= #{q.beginDate} AND x.kind = 'IN' AND x.biz_type = 'PRODUCTION' THEN x.qty ELSE 0 END) AS production_in, SUM(CASE WHEN x.d >= #{q.beginDate} AND x.kind = 'IN' AND x.biz_type = 'SALES_RETURN' THEN x.qty ELSE 0 END) AS sales_return, SUM(CASE WHEN x.d >= #{q.beginDate} AND ((x.kind = 'IN' AND x.biz_type NOT IN ('PURCHASE', 'PRODUCTION', 'SALES_RETURN', 'PRODUCTION_RETURN')) OR (x.kind NOT IN ('IN', 'OUT') AND x.qty > 0)) THEN x.qty ELSE 0 END) AS other_in, SUM(CASE WHEN x.d >= #{q.beginDate} AND x.kind = 'OUT' AND x.biz_type = 'SALES' THEN -x.qty ELSE 0 END) AS sales_out, SUM(CASE WHEN x.d >= #{q.beginDate} AND ((x.kind = 'OUT' AND x.biz_type = 'PRODUCTION') OR (x.kind = 'IN' AND x.biz_type = 'PRODUCTION_RETURN')) THEN -x.qty ELSE 0 END) AS production_out, SUM(CASE WHEN x.d >= #{q.beginDate} AND x.kind = 'OUT' AND x.biz_type = 'PURCHASE_RETURN' THEN -x.qty ELSE 0 END) AS purchase_return, SUM(CASE WHEN x.d >= #{q.beginDate} AND ((x.kind = 'OUT' AND x.biz_type NOT IN ('SALES', 'PRODUCTION', 'PURCHASE_RETURN')) OR (x.kind NOT IN ('IN', 'OUT') AND x.qty < 0)) THEN -x.qty ELSE 0 END) AS other_out FROM ( SELECT f.material_id, f.qty, COALESCE(f.biz_date, d.biz_date, c.biz_date, CAST(f.create_time AS DATE)) AS d, COALESCE(d.kind, f.biz_type) AS kind, COALESCE(d.biz_type, '') AS biz_type FROM wms_stock_flow f JOIN wms_warehouse wh ON wh.id = f.warehouse_id LEFT JOIN wms_stock_doc d ON f.biz_type IN ('IN', 'OUT', 'TRANSFER') AND d.id = f.doc_id LEFT JOIN wms_check c ON f.biz_type = 'CHECK' AND c.id = f.doc_id WHERE COALESCE(f.biz_date, d.biz_date, c.biz_date, CAST(f.create_time AS DATE)) <= #{q.endDate}
AND f.warehouse_id = #{q.warehouseId} AND f.biz_type <> 'TRANSFER'
) x GROUP BY x.material_id ) t JOIN wms_material m ON m.id = t.material_id WHERE (t.open_qty <> 0 OR t.purchase_in <> 0 OR t.production_in <> 0 OR t.sales_return <> 0 OR t.other_in <> 0 OR t.sales_out <> 0 OR t.production_out <> 0 OR t.purchase_return <> 0 OR t.other_out <> 0) AND m.category IN () AND (m.code LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%') OR m.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{q.keyword}, '%')) ORDER BY
m.code m.spec m.category m.unit t.open_qty t.purchase_in t.production_in t.sales_return t.other_in t.sales_out t.production_out t.purchase_return t.other_out
t.open_qty + t.purchase_in + t.production_in + t.sales_return + t.other_in - t.sales_out - t.production_out - t.purchase_return - t.other_out
DESC,
m.code
